desc: Paper notes' quick wheel by controller (TTYD_NOTES_TEST, no relay; Rogueport's harbour, the one note far off): the notes' button (the game's L) held about half a second where no note is near puts up the wheel of eight notes; the stick up, then L let go, leaves the top one (Thank you!); held again and let go with the stick at rest, the wheel stays; (Mario walked off the note just left) the stick right and A leave that one (a boss ahead); held again, let go, then B closes it with nothing left
log_must: ^\[notes\] wheel: left "Thank you!" by the button's release$
^\[notes\] wheel: left "[Aa] boss ahead" by A$
